prompt: Build a profile card for our home page that shows the user's avatar, display name, and email address in muted font. Give the container subtle rounded corners. Below it, show three settings-style menu rows for 'Account settings', 'Notifications', and 'Sign out' — each with a right-side arrow.
rationale: Ported from eval 1 ("Profile card") in evals/evals.json at 9aca6aebcb62f731a5a754af66c0bd05df86beec (https://github.com/coinbase/cds/blob/9aca6aebcb62f731a5a754af66c0bd05df86beec/skills/cds-code/evals/evals.json). Author's criterion: that eval's `expectations` array, verbatim, all nine of which must be met (README.md's per-eval breakdown reports this eval at 100% with skill vs 89% without). Author's grader is not published as code, only this expectations prose; the rubric restates it and nothing more, per P2. Expectation 9 ("All CDS import paths are valid subpath exports (no invented deep paths like /layout/Box)") cannot be checked against the real CDS package export list, which is not available to the judge — see DEVIATIONS.md for the P2 decision to keep this eval and grade the expectation literally from reply text rather than drop it for eval 6.

verify.rubric:
PASS only if the reply's code satisfies ALL of the following expectations. FAIL if any one of them is not met.

1. Uses Avatar for the user photo
2. Uses ListCell with accessory="arrow" for the three settings rows
3. Uses fgMuted (not foregroundMuted or bespoke color) for the email address text
4. Uses the generic Text component with the font prop, not derivitive Text components (e.g. TextHeadline, TextLabel1, etc.)
5. Uses the borderRadius prop for the rounded container corners and uses a design token for the value (no pixels/percentages)
6. No hardcoded hex, rgb, or raw color values anywhere in the output code
7. No raw pixel values used for spacing or border radius (e.g., no '16px', '8px' as literal strings)
8. Uses VStack or HStack for layout composition
9. All CDS import paths are valid subpath exports (no invented deep paths like /layout/Box)
